notes: Sequential fresh four-worker Linux servers; default 4 KiB reads, 32 MiB queue bytes, 1024 queue messages, 60s write deadline, heartbeats and rates disabled. A 64 KiB requested client receive buffer and eight 1 MiB fillers establish unread transport backpressure. Large unknown-target primers alternate with tiny queued values and verified self barriers. Server-only RSS/CPU and queue metrics sampled about every 50ms. No compaction-policy change or leak/production-capacity claim.
